p: JEHOVAH was I not known to: By which he signifies that he will perform indeed that which he promised to their fathers: for this name declares that he is constant and will perform his promise.
take you to me for a: He means, concerning the outward calling, the dignity of which they lost later by their rebellion: but as for election to life everlasting, it is unchangeable.
So hard a thing it is to show true obedience under the cross.
uncircumcised lips: Or barbarous and rude in speech and by this word (uncircumcised) is signified the whole corruption of man's nature.
of their fathers' houses: This genealogy shows whom Moses and Aaron came from.
thirty and seven years: For he was 42 years old when he came into Egypt and lived there 94 years.
father's sister to wife: This type of marriage was later forbidden in the law; Le 18:12.
Korah: Moses and he were cousins, whose rebellion was punished in Nu 16:1.
Naashon: Who was a prince of Judah, Nu 1:7.
armies: For their families were so great, that they might be compared to armies.
uncircumcised lips: The disobedience both of Moses and of the people, shows that their deliverance came only from God's free mercy.
